The Big Unfolding, scale by scale

This is a visual tool to help Ashley understand Emily's ideas. It is not Emily's work and not a statement of her theory. Her ideas are simplified here for a picture, from her written hypothesis as of 6 November 2026; where this page and her own words differ, hers are right. Everything tagged Ashley is his own addition, and nothing here has been checked by a physicist.

Start inside X, the seed of a universe, and zoom out step by step to the loop that holds every universe. Use the ruler, the arrows, or your keyboard's arrow keys. The knobs change the crystal, and you can watch that change carry up through every scale.

    Open threads

    • Open questionWhat breaks frozen time?

      Ashley's chain runs: frozen time fails, the system can observe itself, superposition collapses, the crystal snaps. The first link still needs a cause.

    • AshleyThe startup pattern

      A bulb, a wire, and a computer boot all go through an ordered startup. Work backwards: what is the switch, what turns on first, and in what order?

    • Known physicsColliding membranes as the switch

      The ekpyrotic model, which comes out of string theory, starts each cycle when two membranes collide. It could be one candidate for what flips the switch.

    • Related workSmolin's natural selection

      Lee Smolin proposed that universes reproduce through black holes. It sits close to Emily's picture of black holes birthing daughter universes, and Ashley's additions are meant to complement her work, not compete with it.

    • AshleyWays to test it

      Look for lopsidedness in the afterglow. Look for expansion that runs faster in some directions than others. Check whether either one lines up with the other.
